previewTools.name: preview_math
previewTools.description: Validate and simulate a restricted TypeScript math program or ordered programs batch on a copy of the current workspace. Returns the resulting workspace and engine readbacks, or a validation error. Never applies or saves anything. Do not include history, audio or panel controls.

previewTools.name: preview_explanation
previewTools.description: Validate an interactive explanation and inspect the actual calculated readouts and graph expressions. Returns validation errors for repair. Never changes homework.
